title: B3 routes tab + B4 places tab + getZones/getRoutes/getPlaces envelope fix
tests_added: client.test.ts: getZones unwraps { zones } (NOT { items }); getRoutes unwraps { routes } (ListRoutesResponse); getPlaces unwraps { places } (ListPlacesResponse) — fetch-mocked against the REAL named-envelope shapes, the {routes}/{items} anti-regression (3 tests)

validitySummary.test.ts: all-week+all-day -> 'Po–Ne, celý den'; bounded window 'Pá–So 22:00–06:00'; midnight-wrap verbatim; single day; non-contiguous 'Po, St, Pá, celý den'; HH:mm:ss->HH:mm trim + HH:mm input; validDays 0 -> 'Nikdy'; mixed ranges 'Po–St, Pá' (8 tests)

routeForm.test.ts: per-type validation (P2P from/to+radii; Zone fromZone; ZoneToZone both zones; name/price/days); form->request zeroes off-type fields; HH:mm->HH:mm:ss serialize; blank window->null; bidirectional flag; DTO round-trip HH:mm:ss->HH:mm; toggleDay/isDaySelected bitmask (15 tests)
priorityReorder.test.ts: moveItem down/up/no-op; computePriorityUpdates assigns desc N-1..0 and returns only changed rows; empty when already ordered (5 tests)

RoutesTab.test.tsx: list w/ type badge + cs-CZ price + validity summary (incl. 03:00–04:00 night route); enable toggle -> setRouteEnabled(id,false); move-down -> minimal setRoutePriority (id,priority) tuples; create Zone route via type-aware editor; delete; axe (6 tests)
placeForm.test.ts: validation (name/address/coords/sortOrder>=0); form->request; null-coord coercion; DTO round-trip (7 tests)
PlacesTab.test.tsx: list ordered by sortOrder w/ address + disabled; create via editor w/ pin-resolved coords; coords-required guard blocks save; delete; axe (5 tests)
coverage_delta: +50 net tests (147 files, 940 tests, 0 failures; baseline was 890). New test files: client.test.ts (+3), validitySummary.test.ts (8), routeForm.test.ts (15), priorityReorder.test.ts (5), RoutesTab.test.tsx (6), placeForm.test.ts (7), PlacesTab.test.tsx (5). Customer priceQuote/usePriceQuote/PriceRangeBadge suites stay green after the interpretQuote promotion.
notes: ENVELOPE FIX (folded, red-green, the laneB6a HIGH F1): getZones read data.items but the backend record is ListZonesResponse(Zones) -> { zones }. FIXED getZones to .zones + retyped ListZonesResponse to { zones }. ADDED getRoutes (unwrap { routes } = ListRoutesResponse(Routes)), getPlaces (unwrap { places } = ListPlacesResponse(Places)) + createRoute/updateRoute/deleteRoute/setRouteEnabled/setRoutePriority + createPlace/updatePlace/deletePlace. All TS types mirrored BYTE-FOR-BYTE from the real C# DTOs (read RouteAdminDto.cs, ZoneDto.cs, PlaceDto.cs, Create*/Update*/SetRoute* request records + endpoints): RouteAdminDto carries fromRadiusMeters/toRadiusMeters/isBidirectional/validDays(bitmask)/validFromTime/validToTime(TimeOnly->string|null)/priority/isEnabled; createRoute returns ONLY { id } (CreateRouteResponse), updateRoute returns full RouteAdminDto, setRouteEnabled/setRoutePriority are 204 PATCH. CONFIRMED ENVELOPE SHAPES: zones={zones}, routes={routes}, places={places} — all NAMED, none are {items}. REGRESSION TEST mocks fetch (not the client) returning the real { zones }/{ routes }/{ places } payloads — the style that catches a future drift back to .items at unit level. CROSS-FEATURE-IMPORT FIX (advisor A): promoted the pure interpretQuote + PriceQuoteView to src/shared/pricing/interpretQuote.ts so the dispatcher Otestovat panel reuses them without importing features/customer/* (hard no-cross-feature rule). customer/order/priceQuote.ts now RE-EXPORTS them, so all 5 existing customer importers + priceQuote.test.ts stay unchanged/green. TIMEONLY WIRE FORMAT (advisor B): confirmed from the seeder (new TimeOnly(3,0)) + STJ default -> 'HH:mm:ss'; routeForm serializes outgoing as 'HH:mm:ss', parses incoming/display as 'HH:mm' (defensive split). OTESTOVAT (advisor): useRouteTestQuote is a NEW settings-local hook (NOT the customer usePriceQuote, which omits `at` at line 51) — it threads `at` into both getPriceQuote AND the query key ['pricing','quote','test',...,at]; datetime-local -> toISOString(); always token-gated (Settings is FleetAdmin). DRAG-REORDER: pure priorityReorder.ts (moveItem + computePriorityUpdates) assigns descending priorities top->bottom and PATCHes ONLY changed rows; driven via move-up/move-down buttons (jsdom can't do HTML5 DnD, and buttons are keyboard-accessible + 48px). VALIDITY SUMMARY: pure validitySummary.ts; contiguous run >=2 days -> range 'Pá–So', isolated days listed 'Po, St, Pá', all 7 -> 'Po–Ne'; all-day (no window) -> ', celý den'; bounded -> ' HH:mm–HH:mm' shown verbatim (midnight-wrap is a matching concern not display); 0 days -> 'Nikdy'. Czech day abbreviations are fixed domain constants inside the pure module (statusPill precedent) — not free UI copy. LAZY LEAFLET: one shared PinPickerMap.tsx (routesZones root, reused by RouteEditor P2P pickers + OtestovatPanel + PlaceEditor) is React.lazy in every caller; ZoneEditorMap (B2) + PinPickerMap are separate dist chunks; leaflet is NOT in the main index chunk (the grep 'leaflet' hit is only the OSM attribution string). npm run size = 225.28 kB brotli < 260 kB (was 220 at B2; +5 kB for the 3 new tabs, still well under budget). POINT PICKER SCOPE (conscious AC deviation — flagged): B3 RouteEditor PointToPoint has NO address input at all — coords are map-pin (click/drag) only, with a coordinate-status line. The B3 AC says P2P = 'address autocomplete + map pin'; I ship map-pin only. Rationale: RouteAdminDto has NO address fields (confirmed — only from/to lat/lng), so the address would be a pure UI locating aid the backend never stores; no test and not the AC#4 E2E (which creates a ZONE route, not P2P) depends on it. I did NOT reuse the customer AddressAutocomplete/useSuggest (features/customer/* — cross-feature) and did not build a shared one. The letter-of-AC fix (if the reviewer wants it) is to promote a shared AddressAutocomplete wrapping the shared getGeoSuggest and drop-a-pin-from-search in RouteEditor. NOTE the asymmetry: B4's AC says address autocomplete is OPTIONAL, so PlaceEditor's plain address text field + map pin is fully compliant. theme.colors.primaryLight does NOT exist (despite the web-accessibility rule mentioning it) — used theme.colors.background + a primary border for the Fixed-quote highlight. Removed the dead Placeholder styled-component + the routesComingSoon/placesComingSoon i18n keys (both locales) after un-stubbing the tabs.
